visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds up a plush character in a clear plastic bag; the character is white with pink cheeks and a blue bow, holding a small whale shark. The background shows similar products hanging on a wire rack in a shop. (2) The scene cuts to the exterior of 'Okinawa-ya,' a souvenir shop. A large red sign with white text is prominent, flanked by a Santa Claus statue and a Nutcracker. The camera pans slightly to show the entrance. (3) Close-up shots of various souvenir items inside the shop: boxes of Nestle KitKat (Purple Sweet Potato flavor), rows of Doraemon keychains with price tags of 550 yen, and Snoopy coffee powder packets featuring surfboards and a green car. (4) A large, colorful mascot of a blue penguin wearing a lion-like hat stands at the entrance of a 'Don Quijote' store. The signage indicates it is the Kokusai-dori branch. (5) Inside the store, the camera shows a display of Blue Seal Ice Cream-themed T-shirts in black and white. Another shelf features Hello Kitty and Crayon Shin-chan T-shirts with 'Okinawa' printed on them, depicting characters in tropical settings. (6) The video transitions to the exterior of 'San-A Naha Main Place' at dusk, with its illuminated signage. Inside the mall, large Christmas ornaments and snowflake decorations hang from the ceiling above escalators where people are moving. (7) A shelf displays Disney-themed cookie boxes with Mickey and Minnie Mouse in Okinawan attire. Other food products like Okinawa Rice and Gapao Rice packets are shown. The camera also focuses on individual packs of Jimami (peanut) tofu. (8) The camera pans past 'Global Work' and 'Lakole' fashion storefronts inside the shopping mall. The lighting is bright and typical of a modern mall. (9) Two large, red Shisa (guardian lion) statues with wide-open mouths and bulging eyes are shown close-up. The final screen displays social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube under the brand 'Japanuts.'
